        "All8 owned diffs read in full, including new C++ transaction/header/IDL/build entries and all120 new xpcshell test lines. Same-server CopyMessages now queries IEwsFolder and delegates; cross-server copy/move retains its MessageCopyHandler path. EwsFolder explicitly exposes the new interface. Owned undo is registered only after successful same-server movement when allowUndo, a window and isMove are all true; copy undo and cross-server undo are not enabled by this landing.",
        "Transaction owns original source/destination, window and current destination-header set. Undo reverses folders, redo restores original direction, both disable generating another undo transaction and pass a completion listener owning the transaction. Completion replaces the header set because subsequent moves must use the newly returned headers. Initial DoTransaction is inherited; accepted base implementation is a no-op registration hook, distinct from remote movement already performed.",
        "Owned PerformOperation clears the current header array after scheduling and comments that this prevents another operation during async work. Actual code has no explicit busy/reentry check; clearing leaves empty input, so it is not proved to serialize or reject repeated undo requests. Later accepted PerformOperation no longer clears there. Remote failure path does not call the success operation listener; recovery/error restoration is not tested here.",
        "Owned legacy fallback initiates a destination sync without populating newHeaders locally, yet can still register a move transaction with that empty collection. Also, registering the initial transaction moves newHeaders before a simultaneously supplied operation listener would receive it. The undo path disables registration so its listener receives the new set, but the broader API combination is not covered. Accepted registration clones new arrays, uses a shared transaction service, supports copy transactions and an explicit undoOperationType; those later changes are not attributed to this initial move-only patch.",
        "Success path validates response/header counts, copies/assigns returned IDs, sends move notification and removes source headers before undo registration. Strong captures and the scoped copy-listener guard preserve objects/status notification; unchecked SetStringProperty calls and the asynchronously initiated fallback remain limits. No guarantee of atomic remote/local rollback, cancellation, old-header validity or paired Gecko transaction-manager internals is inferred.",
        "Owned test asserts Inbox/Archives existence, one prefix-matched header after move/undo/redo and nonempty undo/redo stacks.
